newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's unit to redeem $200 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's unit to redeem $200 mln in notes.

text.p: Casino company Harrah's Entertainment Inc said Friday a subsidiary had called for redemption all $200 million of its 10-7/8-percent senior subordinated notes due 2002 on May 27, 1997.
The company said Harrah's Operating Co Inc's call price is at 104.833 percent of the principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest on the notes to the redemption date.

"By refinancing these high interest rate notes we will reduce our debt service costs substantially," it said. "Because of our interest rate swap agreements, we will be able to maintain a ratio of fixed to floating debt of approximately one-to-one after this transaction."
The company said it will draw on its bank credit facility to fund the redemption.
The Bank of New York is trustee for the notes and the paying agent, it added.
